This function provides the link_nodes error-link table pointer.

detaileddescription.para: The table is keyed by the same ErrorId space as ErrorTable[] and holds an index handle (PoolIdx) into the node-id pool for each linked error. It is marked persistent via EXPORT_GENERIC_DS so that boot-time links survive an In-Place PLM Update; because the handles are indices (not pointers) the data survives the update in-place with no fix-up needed.

briefdescription.para: This function provides the link_nodes node-id pool pointer.

detaileddescription.para: The pool is a flat static store of node IDs, referenced by index handles from ErrLinkTable[]. Node IDs are stored verbatim, in CDO order (no dedup, no reorder). It is marked persistent via EXPORT_GENERIC_DS alongside the table.

briefdescription.para: link_nodes command handler body for Versal 2VE/2VM devices.

detaileddescription.para: Parses the CDO payload and links a verbatim, CDO-ordered list of node IDs to an error event. CDO-only (IPI callers are rejected).

parameterdescription.para: is pointer to the command structure

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, or when skipped during an In-Place PLM Update.
XPLMI_INVALID_NODE_ID on invalid node ID or NODE_ALL sentinel.
XST_INVALID_PARAM on invalid parameters / IPI caller.
Error code from XPlmi_LinkNodes on storage failure.
Reject IPI callers: link_nodes is CDO-only.

Skip during In-Place PLM Update: the linkage is restored from the persistent ErrLinkTable/ErrLinkPool DS, and the replayed PMC CDO would otherwise re-append it. The restored table is authoritative, as for the xilpm_ng topology commands that also skip on update.
Need at least EventNodeId + Mask + one node id.
Reject a zero mask: it would leak pool space with no linkage.
Reject NODE_ALL sentinel: link_nodes requires concrete node IDs.
Store the linkage keyed by ErrorId.
